nodes.label: Responsive reflow

nodes.label: Purpose-Gate
nodes.rationale: Visual techniques require a specific purpose.

nodes.label: Evidence-based dashboard data
nodes.rationale: Avoid invented statistics and filler activity.

nodes.label: Bounded Tool Output
nodes.rationale: Document marks this resolved using a 30000-character context limit while retaining fuller output elsewhere.

nodes.label: Disconnected Prototype Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Document identifies regex parsing and missing lifecycle integration as unresolved debt.

nodes.label: Duplicate HTTP Client Stacks
nodes.rationale: Document identifies duplicate ureq and reqwest stacks as unresolved debt.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Integration Session ID
nodes.rationale: Document marks this resolved by passing the real active session to execute_tool_with_context.

nodes.label: Multi-Turn Amnesia Bug
nodes.rationale: Document marks this resolved through active-context reconstruction and preserved tool message order.

nodes.label: Self-Describing Tool Policies
nodes.rationale: Document marks this resolved through ToolActionType and argument-aware permission profiles.

nodes.label: Workspace Image Verification
nodes.rationale: Document marks OCR placeholder resolved through verified local file metadata rather than simulated text.

nodes.label: Design evidence proof gate
nodes.rationale: Accept findings only with a binding contract, proven runtime path and one determinate correction.

nodes.label: Design plan handoff
nodes.rationale: Plans are self-contained and implementation belongs to another agent.

nodes.label: Batched DOM measurement
nodes.rationale: Batch layout reads before writes to avoid layout thrashing.

nodes.label: Compositor motion
nodes.rationale: Prefer transform and opacity to reduce rendering work.

nodes.label: Durable journey verification
nodes.rationale: Declare the final expected state before acting and verify server evidence where relevant.

nodes.label: Flow verdict
nodes.rationale: Unknown and no-fault outcomes do not establish a passing behavior check.

nodes.label: Reticle dev-only SDK
nodes.rationale: Runtime DOM, network, console and framework evidence prove user flows.

nodes.label: UI baseline constraints
nodes.rationale: Prevent generic generated interface patterns through component, spacing and typography constraints.

nodes.label: Backend first deliverable: history baseline and contract proposal

nodes.label: End-to-End Tracing
nodes.rationale: Trace every setting from UI through IPC and engine to the HTTP wire.

nodes.label: Minimal Diff
nodes.rationale: Make only changes required by the explicit request.

nodes.label: Protocols Over Heuristics
nodes.rationale: Use actual runner wire specifications rather than name or port guesses.

nodes.label: Goal-Driven Execution
nodes.rationale: Explicit success criteria support independent verification.

nodes.label: Simplicity First
nodes.rationale: Use the minimum code necessary without speculative abstractions.

nodes.label: Surgical Changes
nodes.rationale: Every changed line must trace to the request.

nodes.label: User Changes Are Sacred
nodes.rationale: Preserve existing edits and avoid destructive Git operations.

nodes.label: Approved minimal storage
nodes.rationale: Approval limits migration to schema_migrations, workspaces, sessions, events and legacy_imports.

nodes.label: Atomic legacy import
nodes.rationale: Byte-verified backups protect originals; a complete session and digest marker commit atomically.

nodes.label: Durable completion boundary
nodes.rationale: Publish completion only after append commits; propagate storage errors through IPC.

nodes.label: History persistence baseline
nodes.rationale: A mock-provider history failure under sandbox reflected blocked writes, not proof of a reconstruction algorithm defect.

nodes.label: Proposed pipeline contract
nodes.rationale: Historical proposal remains unapproved and unimplemented.

nodes.label: Publication snapshot validation
nodes.rationale: Reported 78 of 79 tests passed in an isolated snapshot; shell timeout failure and unused import warning remained.

nodes.label: Runtime ownership lock
nodes.rationale: An OS-backed runtime.lock excludes a second process before opening the database.

nodes.label: SQLite session authority
nodes.rationale: Event insertion, sequence, active leaf and metadata commit together.

nodes.label: Verified backup and restore
nodes.rationale: VACUUM INTO snapshots are integrity and schema checked, and restore refuses overwrite.

nodes.label: Browser preview simulation
nodes.rationale: Browser chat does not exercise native agent execution.

nodes.label: Legacy JSONL and SQLite index
nodes.rationale: README describes JSONL authority and SQLite indexing; newer storage deliverable records a different implementation.

nodes.label: Native single-model workflow
nodes.rationale: Implemented native agent path; runner compatibility still requires verification.

nodes.label: Sequential model collaboration
nodes.rationale: User-defined task sequence remains an incomplete product direction.
